note_en: Adjective or verb + 得 + result shows degree through its consequence: 规则复杂得让她眼花 "the rules were so complicated they made her eyes swim"; 高兴得在床上打了个滚 "so happy she rolled over on the bed"; 嗓子哑得说不出话 "so hoarse he couldn't speak." It works like English "so … that …": instead of saying "very," it shows what the degree led to.
